visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Parallel Arrays Become an Array of Structs
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The name, roll and marks of each student live in three separate arrays that must be kept in step. Group them into a struct and use one array of structs. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Data that belongs together should travel together. With a struct, one index selects a whole student, and the three values can no longer drift out of step.
